primary_question.question: Why is my Chettinad Chicken Curry too spicy or bland?
evidence: Do not use high heat because the chillies and small seeds can burn fast

related_questions.question: Why does my Chettinad Chicken Curry taste bitter or burnt?
evidence: Do not brown the coconut too much or the curry may taste bitter

related_questions.question: Why is my Chettinad Chicken Curry too dense or dry?
evidence: Stop and scrape the grinder so dry bits do not remain

related_questions.question: Why does the oil or fat stage matter for Chettinad Chicken Curry?
evidence: Do not add wet curry leaves to hot oil without care because they may splutter

related_questions.question: Why does my Chettinad Chicken Curry stick or tear?
evidence: Stir often so the onion does not stick
